items.source: Class for creating Function callbacks around sampling methods that return Mono. This class provides a way to convert methods annotated with McpSampling into callback functions that can be used to handle sampling requests in a reactive way. It supports methods with a single CreateMessageRequest parameter.
items.translation: 用于围绕返回 Mono 的采样方法创建 Function 回调的类。 该类提供了一种将带有 McpSampling 注解的方法转换为回调函数的方法，这些回调函数可用于以响应式方式处理采样请求。它支持具有单个 CreateMessageRequest 参数的方法。
